title: spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: Incorrect MOD calculation in example
description:
The example claims '926423932 MOD 7 = 1' yielding channel 2, but the correct calculation is 926423932 MOD 7 = 0 (since 926423932 = 7 * 132346276 exactly), yielding channel 1. The authoritative test vectors file (test/vectors/ccp16.json line 19) confirms the correct answer is channel 1. Implementers verifying against this example would produce incorrect code.

Fix suggestion: Change line 121 from 'Channel = 1 + (926423932 MOD 7) = 1 + 1 = 2' to 'Channel = 1 + (926423932 MOD 7) = 1 + 0 = 1' and change line 123 from 'Result: Channel 2' to 'Result: Channel 1'
close_reason: Already fixed: spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md lines 121 and 123 already show the correct values (1 + 0 = 1, Channel 1). Test vectors also confirm channel=1.
